Appraiser remarks
The vehicle shows front-end damage on the driver's side, consistent with the described
impact during a left turn. The bumper cover is cracked near the fog lamp opening, the
headlamp assembly is broken at its mounting tabs, and the hood edge is bent where it
meets the fender. Damage to the radiator support and the grille frame is reflected in
the estimate. A few shallow scratches along the lower door panel may be older than this
incident and were noted separately from the crash-related repairs. The repair plan
replaces the bumper cover, headlamp, and hood, with refinisihng limited to the
affected panels. The labor hours fit the extent of the damage, and the billing lines
reviewed contain no repeated charges.
